text: 俗话说：“一年之计在于____，一日之计在于晨。”横线上应填什么？
gloss: The proverb: 'The plan for the year lies in ____, the plan for the day in the morning.' — Spring (春): 一年之计在于春.

text: 今天是星期三，十天以后是星期几？
gloss: Today is Wednesday; what day is it ten days later? — Saturday: ten days = one week + 3 days, Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

text: 农历八月十五，一家人团聚赏月，餐桌上最应景的传统点心是什么？
gloss: On the 15th of the 8th lunar month families gather to admire the moon; which traditional treat fits? — Mooncakes (Mid-Autumn Festival); zongzi are for Dragon Boat, tangyuan for Lantern Festival.

text: 大熊猫虽然属于食肉目，却几乎只吃一种植物，每天要吃上十几千克。它是什么？
gloss: Though a carnivoran, the giant panda eats almost one plant, many kilograms a day. What is it? — Bamboo.

text: 冰块能浮在水面上，这说明水结成冰以后，同样质量的水所占的体积发生了什么变化？
gloss: Ice floats on water; so what happens to the volume of a given mass of water when it freezes? — It gets bigger: ice is less dense than water, which is why it floats.

text: 春节时，人们会在大门两侧贴上一副红纸写成的对子，这叫什么？
gloss: At Spring Festival people paste a pair of red-paper couplets on both sides of the door; what is it called? — Chunlian (spring couplets); a 福 character is a single word, not a pair.

text: 桌上有3个苹果，你拿走了2个。现在你手里有几个苹果？
gloss: There are 3 apples on the table and you take 2; how many do you have? — 2: the trap is answering 1, but the question asks what is in your hand.

text: 《西游记》里，会七十二变、一个筋斗能翻十万八千里的是谁？
gloss: In Journey to the West, who knows 72 transformations and can somersault 108,000 li? — Sun Wukong, the Monkey King.

text: 奥运会的会旗上有五个相互连接的圆环，它们象征着什么？
gloss: The Olympic flag has five interlocking rings; what do they stand for? — The five continents (the 'five skin colours' is a popular myth; the Games were founded by far more than five countries).

text: 手机上“扫一扫”识别的那种由许多小黑白方块组成的图案，叫什么？
gloss: The pattern of small black-and-white squares your phone scans — QR code (二维码); a barcode is the one-dimensional striped kind.

text: 统一六国后，推行“书同文、车同轨”，统一了文字、车轨和度量衡的皇帝是谁？
gloss: Which emperor, after unifying the six states, standardised writing, cart axles and weights and measures? — Qin Shi Huang.

text: 尼罗河自南向北流过非洲东北部，最后注入哪片海？
gloss: The Nile flows north through north-eastern Africa; into which sea does it end? — The Mediterranean (the Red Sea is the tempting neighbour).

text: 一架标准钢琴的键盘上，白键和黑键合起来一共有多少个键？
gloss: How many keys, white and black together, does a standard piano have? — 88.

text: 小明面朝北站着，先向右转，再向后转。他现在面朝哪个方向？
gloss: Xiao Ming faces north, turns right, then turns around. Which way does he face now? — West: north, right turn gives east, about-turn gives west.

text: 它生活在海里，却不是鱼：用肺呼吸，还会给幼崽喂奶。下面哪种动物是这样的？
gloss: It lives in the sea but is not a fish: breathes with lungs and nurses its young. Which animal? — The whale; sea turtles breathe air but lay eggs and do not nurse.

text: “桃园三结义”中，除了刘备和关羽，第三位结拜兄弟是谁？
gloss: In the Oath of the Peach Garden, besides Liu Bei and Guan Yu, who is the third sworn brother? — Zhang Fei (the other options are also Shu generals but not part of the oath).

text: 端午节吃粽子、赛龙舟，人们常说是为了纪念哪位诗人？
gloss: Eating zongzi and racing dragon boats at the Dragon Boat Festival is said to commemorate which poet? — Qu Yuan.

text: 画下《星月夜》（又译《星空》）和一系列《向日葵》的荷兰画家是谁？
gloss: Which Dutch painter made The Starry Night and the Sunflowers series? — Vincent van Gogh (Rembrandt is also Dutch, the trap).

text: 春节是农历正月初一，元宵节是农历正月十五。元宵节比春节晚几天？
gloss: Spring Festival is on the 1st of the first lunar month, Lantern Festival on the 15th; how many days later? — 14 days (15 − 1); the autopilot answer is 15.

text: 下面哪个数既是偶数，又是质数？
gloss: Which number is both even and prime? — 2: every other even number is divisible by 2, so 2 is the only even prime.

text: 字谜：“一口咬掉牛尾巴”，谜底是哪个字？
gloss: Riddle: 'a mouth bites off the ox's tail' — which character? — 告: take 牛 (ox), remove the last vertical stroke (its tail) and add 口 (mouth).

text: 夏夜打雷，你看到闪电5秒钟后才听到雷声。闪电大约发生在多远的地方？
gloss: You hear thunder 5 seconds after seeing the lightning; how far away was it? — About 1.7 km: light arrives at once, sound travels about 340 m/s, 340 × 5 = 1,700 m.

text: 世界上第一部完全由电脑制作的长篇动画电影是哪一部？
gloss: Which was the first feature-length film made entirely with computer animation? — Toy Story (1995).

text: 在美第奇家族的资助下，被誉为“文艺复兴摇篮”的意大利城市是哪一座？
gloss: Which Italian city, patronised by the Medici family, is called the cradle of the Renaissance? — Florence.

text: 在鸟类中，以能在花前悬停、甚至倒着飞而闻名的是哪一种？
gloss: Which bird is famous for hovering at a flower and even flying backwards? — The hummingbird.

text: 2024年是龙年。按十二生肖的顺序往后数，2030年是什么年？
gloss: 2024 is the Year of the Dragon; what zodiac year is 2030? — Dog: Snake 2025, Horse, Goat, Monkey, Rooster 2029, Dog 2030. Needs the order of the 12 animals plus counting.

text: 把一根木头锯成3段需要6分钟，如果每次锯的时间相同，锯成4段需要几分钟？
gloss: Sawing a log into 3 pieces takes 6 minutes; how long for 4 pieces at the same pace per cut? — 9 minutes: 3 pieces = 2 cuts = 3 min per cut, 4 pieces = 3 cuts. The trap is 8.

text: 希腊神话中，从奥林匹斯山偷出火种送给人类的是谁？
gloss: In Greek myth, who stole fire from Olympus and gave it to humans? — Prometheus; Hephaestus, the god of fire, is the tempting wrong option.

text: 龙井茶的核心产区位于浙江的哪座城市？
gloss: In which Zhejiang city is the heartland of Longjing tea? — Hangzhou (West Lake Longjing); the other options are real tea-producing Zhejiang cities.

text: 二胡名曲《二泉映月》的作者是谁？
gloss: Who composed the erhu piece Reflection of the Moon on the Second Spring? — Abing (Hua Yanjun). Nie Er wrote the March of the Volunteers, Xian Xinghai the Yellow River Cantata, Liu Tianhua other erhu works.

text: 1405年，派遣郑和率领船队首次下西洋的明朝皇帝是谁？
gloss: Which Ming emperor sent Zheng He on his first voyage in 1405? — Zhu Di (Yongle Emperor); Zhu Zhanji sent the seventh voyage.

text: 寒冬里，深湖的湖面结了冰，冰层之下最深处的湖水温度大约是多少摄氏度？
gloss: In a deep lake capped with ice, how warm is the water at the bottom? — About 4 °C: water is densest at 4 °C, so the densest water sinks and the colder water floats up to freeze at the top.

text: 土耳其的伊斯坦布尔跨在欧亚两洲之间，把这座城市分成欧洲部分和亚洲部分的海峡叫什么？
gloss: Istanbul lies in both Europe and Asia; which strait divides it? — The Bosphorus (the Dardanelles is a separate strait further south-west).

text: 下面哪一部是钱钟书的长篇小说？
gloss: Which of these is Qian Zhongshu's novel? — Fortress Besieged (围城); Border Town is by Shen Congwen, Love in a Fallen City by Eileen Chang, Camel Xiangzi by Lao She.

text: 雅典卫城上的帕特农神庙，供奉的是哪位女神？
gloss: The Parthenon on the Athenian Acropolis was built for which goddess? — Athena, patron of Athens.

text: 从地球向月球发射一束激光，光大约需要多久才能到达月球？
gloss: Fire a laser from Earth at the Moon; how long until it arrives? — About 1.3 s: the Moon is about 384,000 km away and light travels about 300,000 km/s.

text: 1993年，哪一部华语电影获得了戛纳电影节的最高奖项金棕榈奖？
gloss: Which Chinese-language film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 1993? — Farewell My Concubine (shared with The Piano). Red Sorghum won Berlin's Golden Bear, To Live a Cannes jury prize, Raise the Red Lantern a Venice Silver Lion.

text: 咖啡树最早的故乡，在下面哪个国家？
gloss: Where does the coffee plant originally come from? — Ethiopia; Brazil and Colombia are famous producers, Yemen an early centre of cultivation.

text: 农历每月十五前后，月亮最圆最亮。那么农历每月初一的夜晚，月亮是什么样的？
gloss: Around the 15th of each lunar month the Moon is fullest; what is it like on the night of the 1st? — A new moon, almost invisible: the lunar calendar follows the Moon's phases, so the 1st is when the Moon sits between us and the Sun.

text: 二进制数1010等于十进制中的哪个数？
gloss: Which decimal number is the binary 1010? — 10: 8 + 0 + 2 + 0. Needs the positional values 8-4-2-1.

text: 罗塞塔石碑是破译古埃及象形文字的钥匙，最终成功破译这种文字的学者是谁？
gloss: The Rosetta Stone was the key to Egyptian hieroglyphs; who finally deciphered them? — Jean-François Champollion. Thomas Young made partial progress, Schliemann dug Troy, Carter found Tutankhamun's tomb.

text: 从地心量起，地球表面上离地心最远的山峰是下面哪一座？
gloss: Measured from the centre of the Earth, which of these peaks is farthest away? — Chimborazo (Ecuador): the Earth bulges at the equator, so a mountain there outreaches Everest from the centre.

text: 人体内最小的一块骨头藏在耳朵里，它是下面哪一块？
gloss: The smallest bone in the human body is hidden in the ear; which? — The stapes (镫骨, 'stirrup'); the malleus and incus are its neighbours, the pisiform is a small wrist bone.

text: 我们的血液是红色的，是因为血红蛋白里含有铁。章鱼的血液却是蓝色的，因为它的血蓝蛋白里含有另一种金属。是哪一种？
gloss: Our blood is red thanks to iron in haemoglobin; octopus blood is blue thanks to which metal in its haemocyanin? — Copper (cobalt is the blue-compound trap).

text: 互联网和万维网（WWW）并不是一回事。1989年，在欧洲核子研究中心提出万维网构想的人是谁？
gloss: The internet and the World Wide Web are not the same; who proposed the Web at CERN in 1989? — Tim Berners-Lee. Andreessen co-created the Mosaic browser, Torvalds created Linux.

text: 据希腊神话，英雄珀尔修斯斩下美杜莎的头颅时，从她的血液中诞生了谁？
gloss: In Greek myth, when Perseus beheaded Medusa, who was born from her blood? — Pegasus (and Chrysaor); the others are monsters from other myths.

text: “三更灯火五更鸡，正是男儿读书时。”其中的“五更”大约是现在的几点？
gloss: 'Lamplight at the third watch, cockcrow at the fifth: the time for a young man to study.' What time is the fifth watch? — About 3 to 5 a.m.: the night is five watches of two hours from about 7 p.m., so the fifth ends at dawn, with the roosters.

text: 北京约位于北纬40°。夏至这天正午，太阳在北京上空的高度角大约是多少？
gloss: Beijing is at about 40° N; how high is the noon Sun on the summer solstice? — About 73.5°: 90° − 40° + 23.5° (the axial tilt). 50° is the equinox, 26.5° the winter solstice, 90° only on the Tropic of Cancer.

text: “唐宋八大家”中，属于唐代的有两位，其余六位都是宋代人。这两位是谁？
gloss: Of the 'Eight Great Prose Masters of the Tang and Song', two were Tang writers; who? — Han Yu and Liu Zongyuan. Ouyang Xiu, Su Shi and Wang Anshi are Song.

text: 标准围棋棋盘上，一共有多少个可以落子的交叉点？
gloss: How many points can a stone be placed on, on a standard Go board? — 361: the board has 19 lines each way, 19 × 19; 324 (18 × 18) counts the squares, the trap.
